description: Main entry point and API definition for the BackendService of the Subtitle Sync Platform. It includes endpoints for user authentication, file uploads, job processing (subtitle generation, translation, compliance), file download, and administrative functions like listing all users, jobs, and files. It utilizes FastAPI, integrates with several internal modules, sets up middleware and logging, and exposes REST API endpoints with relevant tags and summaries.
